steps.title: Read the labels
steps.body: Type `enable`, then `show mpls forwarding-table`. A packet arrives with label 17: which label does it leave with? `submit OUT17=<label>`. And with label 16: `submit ACTION16=swap`, `pop` or `drop`?

steps.title: Give the Grid its own VRF
steps.body: Run `show ip vrf`: only Moonbase. In `conf t`: `ip vrf GRID`, `rd 64500:65010`, `route-target both 64500:65010`, `exit`. Then `interface g0/3`, `ip vrf forwarding GRID`. Read the warning: the address is gone. Put it back: `ip address 172.20.0.1 255.255.255.252`. `end`, then `show ip vrf` and `show ip route vrf GRID`.

objectives.label: Saw the Grid's routes in its own table

steps.title: Follow the TE tunnel
steps.body: Run `show mpls traffic-eng tunnels brief`. The Grid's priority tunnel does not take the shortest path. `submit AVOID=<router>` with the router it steers around.
